message.sprint.blocked: sprint is disabled on this server
options.sprint.title: sprint Settings
options.sprint.feature.force_sprint.tool: Sprint whenever possible, as if the sprint key were always held. Unlike vanilla's Toggle Sprint, it stays on after death, teleports, dimension changes, rejoining a world, and restarting the game.
options.sprint.feature.ignore_hunger.too: Allow sprinting with 3 or fewer hunger shanks, which vanilla does not allow.
options.sprint.feature.keep_on_collision: Keep sprinting when running into a wall instead of stopping.
options.sprint.feature.sprint_in_place.t: Stay sprinting while standing still, and start sprinting without moving when the sprint key is held or Force Sprint is on. Jumping in place does not push you forward.
options.sprint.feature.omnidirectional.t: Sprint in every direction, not only forward, when the sprint key is held or Force Sprint is on. Sprint jumps push you in the direction you move.
options.sprint.feature.sprint_while_snea: Allow starting to sprint while sneaking, with the sprint key, Force Sprint, or by double-tapping forward.
options.sprint.singleplayer_default.tool: The state of %s restored in singleplayer worlds when a reset applies.
options.sprint.multiplayer_default.toolt: The state of %s restored on servers the multiplayer mode allows when a reset applies.
options.sprint.reset_on_world_exit.toolt: Every world starts from its default states instead of keeping the last states.
options.sprint.reset_on_game_exit.toolti: After restarting the game, the first world where the mod is allowed starts from its default states.
options.sprint.multiplayer_mode.whitelis: Active only on servers in the server list.
options.sprint.multiplayer_mode.blacklis: Active on all servers except those in the server list.
options.sprint.multiplayer_mode.warning: Using this mod on servers may get you kicked or banned. It does not try to bypass any anti-cheat. Use it in multiplayer at your own risk.
options.sprint.edit_servers.tooltip: Edit the addresses used by the whitelist and blacklist modes.
options.sprint.servers.title: Server List
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.sprint: Gives you more control over sprinting: force sprint, sprint when hungry, keep sprinting at walls, sprint in place, omnidirectional sprint, and sprint while sneaking. Disabled in multiplayer by default.
